prompt: /find-missing-states 我在改输入金额页，这是我的 Figma：https://figma.com/design/xxxx 我还漏了哪些状态？
expectedBehaviors: Resolves the screen Chinese name to a COMP_ID via assets/pm-spec-cache/index.yaml
Reads the cached spec state_machine for the full list of states
Reads all Figma frames via the Figma MCP
Buckets frames into Matched / Divergent / Missing / New
Runs common-pitfalls (PIT-XXX) checks and outputs a structured report with next actions

prompt: 微粒贷欢迎页改版完成了，对照下 spec 还缺什么状态，做个状态完整性 gap analysis
expectedBehaviors: Compares the redesign frames against the spec state_machine
Lists states present in the spec but absent from Figma (Missing bucket)

prompt: I'm redesigning the WLD repayment screen in Figma — what states am I missing compared to the spec state machine?
expectedBehaviors: Identifies the component spec for the screen and pulls its state_machine
Produces a coverage diff highlighting missing states
Surfaces pitfall violations relevant to the component

prompt: 改版的微粒贷额度页，没有 Figma MCP 的话也帮我看看缺失状态，spec 里定义了哪些我没覆盖
expectedBehaviors: Falls back to a Spec-Only Walkthrough when the Figma MCP is unavailable instead of faking a diff
Provides the full spec state checklist for manual verification
Still references the component's common pitfalls
